correctness.rationale: Exact reset-resolvent on C_n is the absolutely convergent periodization of the line Green function q^|j|/sqrt(gamma(2-gamma)). Only the two neighbours of the reset vertex merge reset and ordinary-hop destinations, producing the positive entropy loss Delta. The closed deficit h_infty-h_n=2gamma Delta(1+q^2)q^(n-1)/[sqrt(gamma(2-gamma))(1-q^n)] is positive and strictly decreases with n. The optimized-entropy hierarchy follows via finite-state continuity, the small-gamma coefficient 1-2/n, and pointwise ordering. The direct rational Markov checker passed 1,048 assertions; these are diagnostics, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The foundational reset Green-function and collision-entropy correction are acknowledged as prior. The final theorem proves an exact strict entropy ordering between consecutive cycles for every positive reset rate, the exact finite-size deficit and its sharp coefficient, and increasing optimized values. The published graph-wide upper envelope gives none of the adjacent-size or prefactor assertions. Focused published-literature and published-finding corpus searches found no equivalent theorem, although implicit priority coverage remains possible.
residual_risks: Known general regular-graph collision formula and high-girth envelope substantially reduce the breadth of the new result; a reader could derive the cycle formula with periodic Green functions.
Bibliographic searches and primary inspections cannot exclude uncatalogued or differently named prior equivalents.

value.rationale: This is an exact all-rate topology-size ordering for the canonical connected two-regular networks, with a sharp finite-size convergence coefficient and strictly increasing optimal entropies. Network entropy under resetting is a motivated design observable, while the earlier graph-wide envelope supplies only a bound and convergence. The comparison is nontrivial because unreset triangle/square return probabilities cross at three and four steps; a termwise comparison cannot prove it. The result has finite-size information utility, despite the scope limitation to cycles.
